paper.title: Beyond Fresh Starts: Stateful Inference for Streaming ASR in Conversational Voice Agents

evidence.paraphrase: The paper compares streaming ASR state-management strategies using existing conversational speech evaluations. Word error rate measures transcription quality; it does not introduce a separate multimodal agent-memory dataset.

adjudication_notes: Retained from the existing Table 2 as a memory-adjacent evaluation protocol, not counted as a newly introduced benchmark dataset.
